device.category: 5-voice analogue polyphonic synthesizer, 44-key keyboard, with digital effects
device.based_on: Compact sibling of the Prophet-5 Rev 4 (released 2021); shares its platform and front-panel layout with the Oberheim TEO-5 (modelled separately).

sources.title: Sequential Take 5 User's Guide, version 1.1
sources.note: Rear panel, globals, every section, mod matrix (Appendix A sources, B destinations), unison, effects, arpeggiator, sequencer, tunings.

sources.title: Sequential, 'Take 5 MIDI Implementation' V2 (July 2025)

architecture.polyphony_mode: 5-voice polyphonic; unison 1-5 voices with key priority, or chord memory
architecture.patch_memory_note: 256 programs: 128 user and 128 factory (8 banks of 16 each); sequences, chord memory and effects saved per program.
architecture.summary: Per voice: Osc 1 and Osc 2 with octave (5 ranges), pitch (±7 semitones) and SHAPE morphing sine to saw to pulse (pulse width); Osc 2 can frequency-modulate Osc 1 (amount from its level) and Osc 1 can sync to Osc 2; a sub oscillator from Osc 1; bipolar noise (white one way, pink the other). A resonant low-pass filter with drive and key tracking, which self-oscillates. Two DADSR envelopes on fixed routings (filter, amp, aux). LFO 1 global and LFO 2 per voice, each with a direct destination. 16-slot matrix. Overdrive, vintage, one of 11 digital effects plus reverb. Arpeggiator, 64-step polyphonic sequencer, low split.

modules.name: Keyboard and voice assigner
modules.description: 44-key keyboard with velocity and aftertouch or MIDI; 5 voices, unison with key mode, chord memory, latch/hold, per-oscillator glide, transpose, low split.

modules.name: Oscillator 1
modules.description: Analogue VCO: SHAPE morphs sine, saw and pulse (pulse width); octave and pitch; key follow switchable; FM from Osc 2 and sync to Osc 2.

modules.name: Oscillator 2
modules.description: Analogue VCO with the same controls; FM source for Osc 1.

modules.name: Mixer
modules.description: OSC 1, OSC 1 SUB, OSC 2 (or FM amount when FM 2-1 is on) and NOISE levels.

modules.name: Filter
modules.description: Resonant low-pass with drive and key tracking; self-oscillates at high resonance.

modules.name: Envelope 1
modules.description: DADSR: filter envelope or auxiliary (direct destination or matrix) per ENV ROUTING; bipolar amount, velocity.

modules.name: Envelope 2
modules.description: DADSR: amp; filter + amp; or filter + gated amp, per ENV ROUTING.

modules.name: LFO 1 (global)
modules.description: Monophonic LFO: triangle, saw, reverse saw, square, S&H; clock sync; amount to a direct destination; note reset.

modules.name: LFO 2 (per voice)
modules.description: Per-voice LFO with the same controls.

modules.name: Overdrive
modules.description: Overdrive on the voice sum, separate from the digital effects.

modules.name: Effect
modules.description: One digital effect: stereo delay, BBD, tape delay 1/2, chorus, flanger, phaser, HP filter, distortion, ring mod, rotating speaker; delays sync to the clock.

modules.name: Reverb
modules.description: Plate reverb: mix, decay, pre-delay, tone, damping.

modules.name: Arpeggiator and sequencer
modules.description: Arpeggiator (up, down, up+down, random, assign; 1-3 octaves; repeats; relatch) and 64-step polyphonic sequencer; 30-250 BPM, tap tempo, MIDI clock.

modules.name: Output
modules.description: Stereo outputs (or mono), headphones; master and program volume.

parameters.label: OSC 1 SHAPE
parameters.function: Sine to saw to pulse, then narrowing pulse width.

parameters.label: OSC 2 SHAPE
parameters.function: Sine to saw to pulse, then narrowing pulse width.

parameters.label: FM 2-1
parameters.function: Osc 2 frequency-modulates Osc 1; the OSC 2 level knob sets the amount.

parameters.label: ENV ROUTING
parameters.function: Env 1 filter + Env 2 amp; Env 1 aux + Env 2 filter+amp; Env 1 aux + Env 2 filter+gate.

parameters.label: Env 1 aux destination
parameters.function: Direct destination when Env 1 is aux.

parameters.label: TYPE
parameters.note: CC/NRPN range 0-8 in the MIDI document, for 11 listed types.

parameters.label: TIME
parameters.function: Time, rate, frequency, gain, carrier or speed (per type).

parameters.label: FBACK/MISC
parameters.function: Feedback, LPF, resonance, tone, pitch track or mic distance (per type).

parameters.label: Glide Mode
parameters.function: Fixed rate, fixed rate A, fixed time, fixed time A.

parameters.label: LOW SPLIT -1 OCT
parameters.function: Notes below the split an octave lower.

parameters.label: Arp Relatch
parameters.function: New notes restart the held arpeggio.

parameters.label: STEP SEQ RECORD
parameters.function: Step recording (rests, ties); hold with a key to transpose.

parameters.label: Foot Function
parameters.function: Sustain, arp hold, arp hold momentary.

parameters.label: Clock Mode
parameters.function: Off, out, out no S/S, in, in thru, in no S/S.

parameters.label: Basic Program
parameters.function: Loads the Basic Program (also TRANSPOSE down + LATCH).

connections.note: FM amount from the Osc 2 level knob.
With FM on, the OSC 2 knob sets FM depth instead.
Five voices summed, panned in stereo.

mod_matrix.name: Modulation matrix
mod_matrix.note: 16 slots, 19 sources (plus none), 57 destination entries listed (No Dest plus 56); the MIDI document gives destination range 0-54 (55 values). Display marks mono (M) and poly (P) entries.

indicators.label: display
indicators.function: Program, mod slots, menus, effect name, clock division, sequencer step.

behaviours.name: Signal path
behaviours.rule: Per voice: oscillators, sub and noise into the driven low-pass filter, then the VCA and pan. Voices summed into overdrive, one digital effect and the reverb, then stereo out.

behaviours.name: Oscillator shape and FM
behaviours.rule: SHAPE morphs sine, saw and pulse continuously, narrowing the pulse beyond. FM 2-1 lets Osc 2 frequency-modulate Osc 1, with the OSC 2 mixer knob as the FM amount; SYNC 2-1 resets Osc 1 from Osc 2.

behaviours.name: Envelope routing
behaviours.rule: ENV ROUTING cycles Env 1 filter / Env 2 amp; Env 1 aux / Env 2 filter + amp; Env 1 aux / Env 2 filter with gated amp.

behaviours.name: Global and per-voice LFOs
behaviours.rule: LFO 1 is one modulator for all voices; LFO 2 runs per voice. Each has a direct destination and amount; the matrix adds more.

behaviours.name: Unison and chord memory
behaviours.rule: Unison stacks 1-5 voices (detune 0-7, low/high/last priority); a held chord pressed with UNISON is memorised and transposed by single keys.

behaviours.name: Sequencer and arpeggiator
behaviours.rule: 64-step polyphonic step sequencer (notes, chords, rests, ties) saved per program; arpeggiator with five orders, 1-3 octaves, repeats and relatch; clock 30-250 BPM or MIDI.

behaviours.name: Programs
behaviours.rule: 256 programs: 128 user and 128 factory in 8 banks of 16. Basic Program: TRANSPOSE down + LATCH.

midi.note: From Sequential's Take 5 MIDI Implementation V2.

not_in_source: filter slope and circuit (retailers describe a Prophet-5-style 4-pole low-pass)
source_inconsistencies: The reverb section describes a DAMPING knob; the matrix destinations and MIDI tables call the same control 'Reverb Size'.
The MIDI document gives FX Type 0-8 for 11 listed effects, Arp Mode 0-2 for five modes, and Mod 16 Amount as 0-54 (other amounts 0-255).
The global dump lists Take 5 ID 0011 0001 (31) where every other message uses 35, and '27 nibbles for 32 Global parameters'.
Program parameters 0-171 sit under a 'Control NRPN Data' heading said to be 'not saved as part of a program'.
The guide says transpose settings are global and not saved, then that they can be saved per patch.
Arp Repeat is described as '1, 2, 3' then explained from 'off'.
The destination list has 57 entries (No Dest plus 56); the MIDI document gives 0-54 (55 values).

modelling_gaps.detail: Structure mirrors the Oberheim TEO-5 file (same platform) with the Take 5's oscillators, FM, noise, filter, reverb and program count.
LFO 1, LFO 2 and Env 1 (aux) destinations are parameters, not drawn connections.
Voice modules per_voice; LFO 1, overdrive, effects and sequencer common.
